footer_guard: Free to play. No prizes and nothing of value to win. The creator picks the cast, whatever the rankings say.
hero_desc: A round takes about a minute. Finish one this week and you can apply to be in the next video.
daily_limit: 3 free tries per mission a day
desc_no-rieul: Answer 8 Korean categories without the letter ㄹ. 사과 works, 딸기 is out.
desc_telepathy: Pick what most people will pick. There's no right answer, only the majority.
desc_ore-hunt: Each dig shows how far the nearest ore is. Find as many of the 12 hidden ores as you can.
casting_cta_title: Finish one round and you can apply to be cast.
rule_no-rieul_1: Enter a Korean word that belongs to the category.
rule_no-rieul_2: A ㄹ in the initial or final consonant, or a reused word, ends the run.
rule_no-rieul_3: 7 seconds a round, plus 1.5 seconds for slow connections. The server keeps score.
rule_telepathy_1: Choose one of four options within 5 seconds.
rule_telepathy_2: Earn 100 points for matching the current majority. Tied choices all count.
rule_telepathy_3: Scores lock in when the mission closes and can change until then.
rule_ore-hunt_1: Dig up to 25 cells in 60 seconds.
rule_ore-hunt_3: An empty cell shows the distance to the nearest undiscovered ore.
free_only: Free to play · No cash or prizes
nickname_hint: Visible on the leaderboard. Avoid your real name.
word_hint: Enter a Korean word. No voice is collected.
ore_legend: Smaller distance means closer. Iron 10 · Gold 30 · Gem 100
result_timeout: Time's up. Everything up to here is saved.
result_invalid: That word doesn't count. It has ㄹ, misses the category or was already used.
provisional: Provisional score · Locked in when the mission closes
display_only: Ranking badges are for show and carry no value.
no_records: No records yet. Be the first.
no_my_rank: Finish a mission to see your rank.
eligible: You can apply. Your best runs this week are attached.
not_eligible_msg: Finish one mission this week first. Any score counts.
age_hint: Ages 14 and up. We don't ask for your birthday, so your birth year has to make you 15 this year. We don't store it.
contact_hint: Only used to contact you about casting. No phone numbers.
consent: I agree to share my contact details for casting. My application and contact details are deleted 30 days after I apply.
casting_step1: Your runs from this week are attached.
casting_step2: The creator reads your intro and picks the cast.
casting_step3: If you're picked, you'll hear back at the contact you left.
casting_sent_desc: If you're picked, the creator will reach out. Applying doesn't guarantee a spot.
logo_hint: Your own PNG/JPEG, up to 200 KB
ad_required: Every sponsored screen has a fixed advertising label. Entry fees and rewards cannot be configured.
report_note: Players are counted by device. Completion includes failed and timed-out runs with recorded results. Time and score averages use finished runs.
sponsor_title:
Run a mission
under your brand.
sponsor_desc: Viewers play for free. You get a report on how many played and how many finished.
sponsor_step1_desc: Choose one of three missions and set the title, color, your own logo and dates.
sponsor_step2_desc: Players, completion rate, average scores and link visits by day, with a CSV export.
sample_note: Real numbers live in the studio report. Public pages never show player details.
sponsor_contact_empty: Ask the creator about a sponsored mission. No payments are taken here.
faq_0_a: No. There is no money, merchandise, coupons or anything else of value. Ranking badges are just for show.
faq_1_q: Does a high rank guarantee casting?
faq_1_a: The creator picks the cast. Finish any mission this week and you can apply, whatever your score. Recordings are run separately from this site.
faq_2_a: It's free, with three tries per device for each mission. No paid retries and no paid random items.
faq_3_a: Playing uses an anonymous device token and a nickname. Casting is for ages 14 and up, and contact details are only used for casting. Applications and contact details are deleted automatically after 30 days.
faq_4_a: No. You answer by typing. The mic stays off and no audio is sent to the server.
faq_5_a: Every sponsored mission screen keeps a 광고 · Sponsored by label pinned at the top. The rules are the same as any other mission.
